logp.method_description: 1-Octanol/water partition coefficients (Po/w) for Ru-Fc and [Ru(bpy)2(COOH-bpy)](PF6)2 were obtained using the 'shake-flask' method. Briefly, Ru-Fc or [Ru(bpy)2(COOH-bpy)](PF6)2 was dissolved in water (1.0 mM), and further diluted with 2.0 mL of 1-octanol-saturated PBS (pH 7.4). Then 2.0 mL of water-saturated 1-octanol solution was added into the solution with continuous stirring. The mixture was stirred at room temperature for another 2 h, and then the concentrations of the complex in water phase and oil phase were determined by the absorbance measurements. The above experiment was repeated three times.
